name: Dôme Bathyal

Subject: the interior floor of a pressurized deep-sea bathyal dome, circular steel and glass ribs at the perimeter, dark teal viewing windows to the ocean, subtle coral pink and violet bioluminescence, a wide clear central metal plaza. Respect this exact visual domain: Sous-Marin Abyssal, Récifs Mécaniques & Caustiques Lumineuses. Palette: {"bg":"#042f2e","primary":"#2dd4bf","secondary":"#a855f7","glow":"#fb7185"}. Elevated nearly top-down orthographic 2.5D camera, no horizon or perspective vanishing point; match the reference's game-ready detailed surfaces. The central 65 percent of the image must be a calm empty unobstructed continuous walkable surface so the game can place its own characters, defense rings and citadel. Put tall architecture, spectacle and decoration in the outer 15 percent border only. Four subtle broad approach directions meet an empty central area; no painted obstacles crossing them. Elaborate illustrated materials and lighting, polished cyber-gothic dark fantasy game art, high resolution, no vector clip art. No characters, enemies, towers, weapons, central citadel, UI, text, lettering, labels, grids or watermark. Entire image opaque, no transparency. This is a FIRST original design following the written DLC brief, not a copied design.
